goal: A student enjoys fixing objects but feels pressure to choose what high scorers pick.

turns.say: Everyone at school says good marks mean Science, so I'm confused.
At home I got our old toy car running again by opening it and fixing the loose wire.
I enjoy repairing things and figuring out why they stop working.
My school has Physics and Chemistry, but I haven't checked its Maths options.

goal: Distinguish creative writing from enjoying the spotlight.

turns.say: I enjoyed the annual school play.
I wasn't acting. I kept changing the ending because the dialogue sounded stiff.
I like writing the dialogue and reading different endings. I don't enjoy speaking in front of everyone.
I'd rather try writing the next school play.

goal: Discover interest in measuring a practical problem without equating it to engineering.

turns.say: I got annoyed that our lunch queue never moved.
I timed two queues for a week and drew a graph of which line moved faster.
I enjoyed spotting patterns in the waiting times and testing whether another counter would help.
I want to use data to compare everyday decisions.

goal: Separate the accounting activity the student likes from the public-facing sales activity.

turns.say: Diwali ke stall pe sab log customers bula rahe the, main side mein tha.
Mujhe receipts aur accounts check karna pasand hai. Pitch banana utna pasand nahi.
I liked finding why the cash and the entries did not match.
Mere school mein Accountancy aur Economics hai, Maths ka pata nahi.

goal: Find an interest in helping and explaining rather than assuming a subject choice from marks.

turns.say: Main maths mein average hoon. School ka stream abhi decide nahi hua.
Mujhe chhote students ko fractions samjhana aur padhana pasand hai.
Mujhe maza tab aata hai jab unko apni galti khud samajh aati hai.
I enjoy explaining problems in a way that makes sense to someone younger.

goal: Identify coordination rather than inferring a career directly from a sport.

turns.say: I enjoy kabaddi practice.
The part I like is making sure everyone has a role, especially the new players.
I enjoy planning drills and getting a group to agree on how to play.
I like organising people more than calculating scores.

goal: Explore a less familiar creative medium and avoid assuming public performance.

turns.say: Friends ke function ke liye audio mix banaya tha. Main stage pe nahi tha.
Mujhe alag alag sounds ko jodna aur ek scene ke liye music choose karna pasand hai.
I enjoy creating the mood, like when the background music changes the meaning of a scene.
I would rather edit the soundtrack than perform it.

goal: Biology interest and chemistry discomfort should both survive the conversation.

turns.say: I enjoy looking after the plants on our terrace.
I tested which seedlings grew faster by moving the pots to different windows.
I like observing plants and working out why one group grows faster.
I don't like balancing chemistry equations. I still want to understand living things.

goal: Avoid recommendations based solely on marks, vague preferences, or family wishes.

turns.say: I scored 91 in Maths and 62 in English. Does that decide my stream?
I can't think of an activity I enjoy yet.
My parents want me to study engineering.
What did I mention?

goal: Separate a potential fit for economics from a school that may lack a combination.

turns.say: I haven't decided. Our local school is much easier for me to reach.
I looked up why milk prices rose while the packets stayed the same size.
I enjoy comparing prices, modelling demand, and checking which explanations match the data.
I only have a list of Economics, English and History at my school.

goal: Family input should remain separate after the learner expresses visual design preferences.

turns.say: Papa chahte hain main Biology loon. Mujhe abhi decide karna hai.
Mujhe school newsletter ke cover ka layout banana pasand hai.
I enjoy designing posters, especially making a page easier to understand.
Maine kya bataya?

goal: A PCM student is interested in drainage and modelling a physical site.

turns.say: I helped neighbours figure out why our lane always collects rainwater.
I drew a plan showing which direction the water flows and where a drain might fit.
I enjoy designing structures, drawing site plans, and testing how different materials hold up.
I like working on infrastructure people will actually use.

goal: Differentiate ecology fieldwork from collecting statistics as a primary interest.

turns.say: I joined a morning bird count near the lake.
The next week I went back to see why some birds were near the reeds and others weren't.
I enjoy mapping biodiversity and observing how animals respond to a change in their environment.
I would prefer outdoor field research to only working with a spreadsheet.

goal: Separate statistics interests from coding expectations and clarify a student concern.

turns.say: Sab log bolte hain data ke liye software engineer banna padta hai.
Mujhe cricket ke data mein patterns analyse karna aur uncertainty samajhna pasand hai.
I enjoy comparing data distributions. I don't enjoy debugging a program.
What did I mention?

goal: Differentiate history and literature when the learner likes interpreting source documents.

turns.say: We found letters my grandmother kept from when she moved to another city.
I liked comparing dates in the letters with newspaper archives.
I enjoy examining historical documents and comparing sources when they disagree.
I want to know what changed at that time before I try to tell the story.

goal: Distinguish chemical experimentation from an interest in the culinary outcome.

turns.say: Ghar pe achar banate waqt ek batch ka colour jaldi badal gaya.
Maine teen jars mein namak badal ke dekha, taste ke liye nahi, reason samajhne ke liye.
I enjoy comparing reaction rates and recording experimental observations.
The chemical changes are more interesting to me than presenting the food.

goal: Compare behavioural research with volunteering while retaining both interests.

turns.say: I'm part of a volunteer group that helps students settle in at a new school.
I enjoy listening to students when they feel out of place.
I started interviewing classmates too because I wanted to compare their study habits.
I want to test explanations for why a new routine helped some people more than others.

goal: Identify evidence checking and reporting when a student also has editing skills.

turns.say: I shot some clips about a protest for our college noticeboard.
The editing was okay, but I spent more time checking which claims in the interviews were true.
I enjoy fact-checking an account and writing a news story from several interviews.
I want to report what happened rather than pitch a campaign.

goal: Exam eligibility remains conditional even with a clear accounting interest.

turns.say: I've just finished Commerce. A friend says passing accounts automatically makes you eligible for CA.
I enjoy checking a ledger and tracing the entry that caused expenses to be counted twice.
I liked reconciling the group expenses. I would rather analyse the records than give a sales presentation.
I haven't confirmed my registration for the Foundation exam.

goal: Look for user-centred product design rather than automatically treating sketching as literature.

turns.say: Mausi ko kapde fold karne mein dikkat thi toh maine ek chhota stand banaya.
Mujhe sketch karke dekhna pasand tha ki unko kaunsa handle comfortable lage.
I enjoy testing layouts and designing an object for a user, then making a working prototype.
I want to change the design based on how a person actually uses it.

goal: No model should turn a lack of exposure into a negative score or a recommendation.

turns.say: Maine kabhi coding try nahi ki. Shared phone hai ghar par.
I haven't been able to try lab work, and I don't know if I would enjoy it.
Mere dost sab BCA choose kar rahe hain.
Maine kya bataya?

goal: A student withdraws an earlier personal preference and states a different genuine interest.

turns.say: I used to like building model engines.
That was last year. I don't enjoy mechanical projects now.
I enjoy reading Gujarati stories and interpreting Gujarati poems. I write a short story in Gujarati every week.
The work I want to explore now is analysing Gujarati literature.
